definition.en: The connected frame made by all the bones in the body.
definition.zh: 身体各处的骨连成的支架。

definition.en: A place where bones meet. Some joints move freely, while others hardly move.
definition.zh: 骨与骨相接的地方。有的关节活动灵活，有的几乎不动。

definition.en: Tough, springy connective tissue. Connective tissues support or link body parts. In a synovial joint, cartilage covers the facing bone surfaces.
definition.zh: 坚韧而有弹性的结缔组织。结缔组织能支持或连接身体各部位。在滑膜关节中，软骨覆盖相对的骨面。

definition.en: Dense, hard bone tissue. It forms the wall around the shaft, or middle part, of a long bone.
definition.zh: 密实、坚硬的骨组织。它构成长骨中段，也就是骨干的外壁。

definition.en: Hard bone tissue that forms a network of thin struts. There are spaces between the struts.
definition.zh: 由坚硬的骨小梁连成的网架，小梁之间有空隙。

definition.en: Soft tissue inside bones. Red marrow makes blood cells. Yellow marrow contains much fat.
definition.zh: 骨内的软组织。红骨髓制造血细胞，黄骨髓含有较多脂肪。

definition.en: A layer of tissue covering most of a bone’s outer surface. It contains blood vessels and nerves.
definition.zh: 覆盖骨大部分外表面的一层组织，内有血管和神经。

definition.en: Strong tissue that supports the connection between bones and helps stop a joint moving too far.
definition.zh: 支持骨与骨之间连接的坚韧组织，帮助限制关节的过度活动。

definition.en: Strong tissue that carries a muscle’s pull to a bone.
definition.zh: 把肌肉的拉力传到骨的坚韧组织。

definition.en: Fluid in the space inside a synovial joint. It lubricates the facing surfaces so they move smoothly.
definition.zh: 滑膜关节腔内的液体。它润滑相对的表面，让关节活动顺畅。

definition.en: A type of synovial joint that mainly bends and straightens around one axis, or line of rotation.
definition.zh: 主要能弯曲和伸直的一类滑膜关节，活动绕着一条转轴进行。

definition.en: A type of synovial joint that turns around one main axis, or line of rotation.
definition.zh: 主要绕一条转轴旋转的一类滑膜关节。

definition.en: A joint where a rounded bone head fits into a socket. It can move around several axes, or lines of rotation.
definition.zh: 圆形骨头嵌在关节窝内的关节，可绕多条转轴活动。

definition.en: A type of synovial joint that moves around two main axes, or lines of rotation. A finger knuckle is an example.
definition.zh: 可绕两条主要转轴活动的一类滑膜关节，指根关节就是例子。

definition.en: A joint with two matching, saddle-shaped surfaces. Each surface curves inwards in one direction and outwards in the other. The thumb base is an example.
definition.zh: 相对的两个关节面像相配的马鞍。每个面沿一个方向凹、另一个方向凸。拇指根部的关节就是例子。

definition.en: A type of synovial joint with fairly flat surfaces. These usually allow only small gliding movements.
definition.zh: 关节面较平的一类滑膜关节，通常只能作小幅滑动。

definition.en: A stiff structure that turns around a fixed point, called a pivot, when forces act on it.
definition.zh: 受力时能绕支点转动的硬杆或其他坚硬结构。

definition.en: The shortest distance from a pivot to a force’s line of action. Measure it at right angles to that line.
definition.zh: 支点到力的作用线的最短距离，测量方向与作用线垂直。

definition.en: A region of cartilage near the end of a young long bone. The bone grows longer here.
definition.zh: 幼年长骨靠近骨端的一片软骨区域，骨在这里增长。

definition.en: The removal of old bone tissue and growth of new bone tissue. This continues after a person stops growing taller.
definition.zh: 去除旧骨组织、形成新骨组织的过程。身高停止增长后，骨的重塑仍会继续。
